sources.title: Qwen 3.6 27B Local Setup Guide 2026: Coder, VL & Hardware Tiers
sources.snippet: The new flagship pick is Qwen 3.6 27B — a dense, Apache 2.0 model with a 256K context window that runs in ~17 GB of VRAM at Q4_K_M via `ollama run qwen3.6:27b`. For a lighter setup, Qwen3 8B installs with Ollama and `ollama pull qwen2.5:7b` — 5.5 GB of VRAM, 57 tokens/sec on an RTX 3060.
